mapper.select: select from org_tenant_memberships where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and user_id=#{userId} order by case when status='REMOVED' then 1 else 0 end,updated_at desc limit 1
select from org_tenant_memberships where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and membership_id=#{membershipId}
mapper.update: update org_tenant_memberships set status=#{row.status},employee_id=#{row.employeeId},expires_at=#{row.expiresAt},updated_at=#{row.updatedAt},updated_by=#{row.updatedBy},status_reason=#{row.statusReason},default_tenant=#{row.defaultTenant},membership_source=#{row.membershipSource},version=#{row.version} where tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} and membership_id=#{row.membershipId} and version=#{expectedVersion}

mapper.select: select from departments where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and department_id=#{departmentId}
select count(*) from departments where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and department_code=#{code} and status<>'DELETED'
select from departments where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and manager_user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE' order by department_name
select from departments where manager_user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE' order by tenant_id,department_name

select count(*) from org_department_closure c join departments d on d.tenant_id=c.tenant_id and d.department_id=c.descendant_department_id where c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and c.ancestor_department_id=#{departmentId} and c.depth>0 and d.status='ACTIVE'
mapper.update: update departments set department_code=#{row.code},department_name=#{row.name},parent_department_id=#{row.parentDepartmentId},manager_user_id=#{row.managerUserId},status=#{row.status},display_order=#{row.displayOrder},updated_at=#{row.updatedAt},updated_by=#{row.updatedBy},version=#{row.version} where tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} and department_id=#{row.departmentId} and version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select count(*)::bigint from (select pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(concat('iam-department:',#{tenantId}),0))) locked
mapper.insert: insert into org_department_closure(tenant_id,ancestor_department_id,descendant_department_id,depth) select tenant_id,department_id,department_id,0 from departments where tenant_id=#{tenantId}

with recursive h as (select d.tenant_id,d.parent_department_id ancestor_id,d.department_id descendant_id,1 depth from departments d where d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and d.parent_department_id is not null union all select h.tenant_id,p.parent_department_id,h.descendant_id,h.depth+1 from h join departments p on p.tenant_id=h.tenant_id and p.department_id=h.ancestor_id where p.parent_department_id is not null and h.depth<10) insert into org_department_closure(tenant_id,ancestor_department_id,descendant_department_id,depth) select tenant_id,ancestor_id,descendant_id,depth from h where ancestor_id is not null
mapper.select: select d.department_id as "departmentId",d.parent_department_id as "parentDepartmentId",coalesce(max(c.depth),0) as depth from departments d left join org_department_closure c on c.tenant_id=d.tenant_id and c.descendant_department_id=d.department_id where d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} group by d.department_id,d.parent_department_id

select a.department_id as "departmentId",a.department_code as code,a.department_name as name,c.depth from org_department_closure c join departments a on a.tenant_id=c.tenant_id and a.department_id=c.ancestor_department_id where c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and c.descendant_department_id=#{departmentId} order by c.depth desc

mapper.update: update org_department_revisions set valid_to=#{validTo} where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and department_id=#{departmentId} and valid_to is null
mapper.insert: insert into org_department_revisions(tenant_id,department_id,revision,department_code,department_name,parent_department_id,ancestor_path_ids,ancestor_path_codes,ancestor_path_names,valid_from,valid_to,change_type,changed_by,change_reason,created_at) values(#{row.tenantId},#{row.departmentId},#{row.revision},#{row.departmentCode},#{row.departmentName},#{row.parentDepartmentId},case when #{row.ancestorPathIdsCsv}='' then '{}'::varchar[] else string_to_array(#{row.ancestorPathIdsCsv},chr(31)) end,case when #{row.ancestorPathCodesCsv}='' then '{}'::varchar[] else string_to_array(#{row.ancestorPathCodesCsv},chr(31)) end,case when #{row.ancestorPathNamesCsv}='' then '{}'::varchar[] else string_to_array(#{row.ancestorPathNamesCsv},chr(31)) end,#{row.validFrom},#{row.validTo},#{row.changeType},#{row.changedBy},#{row.changeReason},#{row.createdAt})
